$comment: The retained-mode UI library behind bblite/pal_ui.hpp. vcpkg carries an rmlui port, but not at this pinned revision and not carrying native/patches/rmlui-premultiplied-rounding.patch and rmlui-css-box-model.patch (docs/ui.md states what each corrects), so the library is built from this commit by tools/build-rmlui.ps1 into artifacts/tools/rmlui -- the same shape the pinned Dawn, Tint and LabSound builds take. The script applies the patches, enables RmlUi's inline-SVG plugin, and installs Backends/RmlUi_Platform_SDL.{h,cpp}, which RmlUi builds only under its samples and never installs; FreeType and LunaSVG stay vcpkg concerns supplied by the ui manifest feature for both the artifact build and each consuming tree.
